title: Islam ke pyare Aon o Mohd
body:
AUN-O-MOHAMMED AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<MINI>>
ISLAM KEY PYARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
MAA SADQE TUMHARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<DIVIDER>>
JO MAA KI TAMANNA THI PYARE
AYE HAIN HAI LAASHE RUN SE TUMHARE
<<MINI>>
MAA SADQE TUMHARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
ISLAM KEY PYARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<DIVIDER>>
NAZAO SE PALA THA TUMKO
KIS DIL SE SAWARA THA TUMKO
THE SHEH KEY DULHARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<MINI>>
ISLAM KEY PYARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<DIVIDER>>
ABBAS-E-ALI KEY NOORE NAZAR
HO AAP KAHA ZAINAB KEY PISAR
<<MINI>>
BHAI KEY SAHARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
ISLAM KEY PYARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<DIVIDER>>
JO MAA KA IRADA THA DIL MEIN
POORA HUA TUMSE MAQTAL MEIN
THE PYAAS KEY MAARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<MINI>>
ISLAM KEY PYARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<DIVIDER>>
HO AAP KAHA HUM KO BOLO
GHAR KAAT NEY AATA HAI MUJHKO
MAA TUM KO PUKARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<MINI>>
ISLAM KEY PYARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<DIVIDER>>
YEH HAAL JO MAA KA HOTA HAI
IQBAL MADINA ROTA HAI
AAYEIN NA HAMARE AUN-O-MOHAMMED
<<MINI>>
ISLAM KEY PYARE AUN-O-MOHAMME
